title: Kit Green's CIA files on UFO-related injuries given to Gary Nolan

tellings.quote: think the whatever CIA files around biological interactions from you know, people interacting with UFOs. That was given to um Gary Nolan in the like mid-2010s.

plain: A CIA scientist named Kit Green held agency files on the biological effects suffered by people who had encounters with UFOs, and those files were handed to the scientist Garry Nolan around the mid-2010s. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as the starting point for Nolan's own study of people harmed in such encounters.
